jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Developer (react)
jobs_results.description:
¿Te apasionan los viajes🛫 , la cultura🗽 y el ocio🎡 y tienes ganas de participar en el crecimiento de la empresa Nº 1 en servicios turísticos en español? Nuestro equipo no para de crecer y buscamos personas con talento e ilusión por desarrollarse.

Somos un equipo joven, multicultural e innovador, que entiende cada día como un desafío y una nueva oportunidad para crecer junto con la empresa.

Si quieres conquistar el mundo con nosotros, ¡te estamos esperando🚀💥!

Buscamos una persona para incorporarse a nuestro Departamento de IT, como Desarrollador Frontend (react) en nuestras oficinas de Madrid (Gran Vía).

¿Cómo será tu día a día?
• Apoyo al equipo de IT.
• Desarrollo de las herramientas de gestión internas y externas para la plataforma.
• Mantenimiento de nuestra web.
• Transformación digital (proyecto de nuevas funcionalidades y best practices)

¿Qué buscamos?
• Cuatro o cinco años de experiencia en desarrollo frontend.
• Es fundamental la experiencia con: Javascript y... react.
• Es fundamental y excluyente: html, css y Sass (maquetación).
• Valorable conocimientos y/o experiencia en typescript.
• Valorable conocimiento en alguno de los siguientes frameworks: Angular o Vue.
• Valorable: PHP y alguna base de datos.
• Muchas ganas de aprender, valoramos mucho la buena actitud y el trabajo en equipo.
• Es fundamental poder realizar trabajo presencial en Madrid (Gran Vía).

¿Por qué Civitatis?
• Formarás parte del líder mundial de reserva online de excursiones y visitas guiadas en español💃🏽.
• Espíritu joven, viajero y gran ambiente de trabajo. ¡20 nacionalidades🌏🌎!
• Hay vida más allá del trabajo: Flexibilidad horaria (gestionas tu horario de entrada y salida), jornada intensiva de verano, modalidad de trabajo hibrida (días en nuestra oficina de Gran vía y desde casa) y medidas de conciliación.
• ¡23 días laborables de vacaciones de libre elección más tu día de cumpleaños!
• Eventos de teambuilding 🎉 (desayunos, pádel, senderismo, etc.)
• Planes voluntarios de retribución flexible para sacar el máximo partido a tu salario.
• Nunca dejarás de aprender. Planes de desarrollo y formación continua (LinkedIn Learning).
• ¡Equipo sano, equipo feliz! Tenemos fruta siempre a mano 🍌🍊, clases de yoga gratuitas y co-financiamos el gimnasio. 🧘🏽♀️🧘🏽♀️
• Formación en idiomas: Clases de inglés con profesores nativos.
• Podrás disfrutar de nuestras más de 88.000 actividades con un super descuento.
• Trabajarás en el corazón de Madrid. Oficinas junto a la Puerta del Sol.

¿Te sumas 🚀💥

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer for the Space Sector
jobs_results.description:
Do you want to face new challenges without giving up the stability of a highly experienced technology group? At GMV…

We are expanding our teams in the space sector to take on projects within the areas of Space Surveillance and Tracking and Space Traffic Management.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our team, you will be integrated into a multidisciplinary team of Space Surveillance and Tracking (SST) and Space Traffic Management (STM) at GMV, located in several countries, with various ongoing projects.

Space Traffic Management is becoming an increasingly relevant topic due to the need to manage the traffic of objects orbiting the Earth, whether space debris or operational satellites, which are currently growing and expected to increase further due to the launch of mega-constellations.

The main responsibilities will include:
• Design and implementation of the... web User Interface of a System to monitor space debris
• UX/UI Design
• Develop reusable UI components
• Collaborate with others in a geographically distributed team.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are seeking software engineers or similar with education and interest in frontend development.

We will also consider prior experience and knowledge in:
• React
• Typescript
• CSS
• REST API
• JavaScript 3D library
• Linux
• Docker
• Spring Boot

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Sandra Bravo Crespo, in charge of this vacancy.

Sandra Bravo Crespo

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
En AXPE Consulting estamos transformando el mundo de la Tecnología. Por ello, te invitamos a vivir una experiencia única desarrollando tu carrera en una Compañía multinacional que mira hacia el futuro. Nuestros valores definen nuestra identidad, son la palanca que nos ayuda a hacer realidad nuestro propósito y guían todas nuestras acciones y decisiones: apostamos por el TALENTO.

Desde el departamento de IT, buscamos un perfil de Senior Frontend Developer para participar en un proyecto tecnológico interesante y retador de uno de nuestros principales clientes 👩🚀🚀

¿Cuál es tu reto?
• Buscamos una persona proactiva con compromiso con el producto, para desarrollar diferentes Development Tools.
• Formarás parte de un equipo de desarrollo para crear y mantener varias aplicaciones.
• Te encargarás de implementar todas las funcionalidades que se vayan incorporando a las nuevas herramientas del producto.
• Tendrás que testear y validar todos los desarrollos creados.

¿Qué buscamos de ti?
•... Experiencia de 5 años en Desarrollo Front con React +v18.
• Experiencia manejando todos los estados de React como por ej. Redux.
• Programar con JavaScript, TypeScript, Next.js, Express.js, etc.
• Conocimientos en maquetación con CSS, PostCSS, SASS...
• Experiencia en testing con Jest, Cypress y/o React Testing Lybrary.
• Conocer repositorios Git tal como Feature branch workflow.
• Trabajar bajo metodología Agile.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

📈 Oportunidad de desarrollar tu carrera en contexto global.

👨💻 Contrato indefinido.

⚕ Seguro médico a precio reducido (para ti y familiares directos).

📚 Formaciones y certificaciones a nuestro cargo, que te permitan crecer profesionalmente junto a nosotros.

⏰ Horario estándar con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.

📍 Modalidad 100% remota.

💸 Salario competitivo.

🚀 Formar parte de una compañía donde se fomentan las comunidades tecnológicas, el intercambio de conocimiento y la excelencia técnica.

En AXPE estamos orgullosos de ser una empresa experta en tecnología que apuesta fuerte por el talento. La responsabilidad corporativa es inherente a nuestro modelo de negocio, impulsamos la educación tecnológica tanto a nivel formativo como laboral.

📢 📢 Formar parte de AXPE es liderar la transformación del sector tecnológico

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Developer SAP UI5 (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
Workload: 100%

Join Axpo's innovative IT team in Madrid as a Frontend Developer specializing in SAP UI5. Backed by a leading energy production company, you'll have the opportunity to influence the IT landscape by supporting the implementation of SAP S4/HANA and enhancing existing systems to meet evolving business needs. If you're passionate about front-end development and eager to make a tangible impact in a dynamic, international environment, we'd love to meet you.

What you will do:
• Design, develop, and optimize SAP UI5/Fiori applications to meet business requirements and design specifications.
• Ensure seamless integration with SAP backend systems using OData services.
• Conduct code reviews and adhere to coding standards to ensure quality and performance.
• Collaborate with UX/UI designers to transform high-fidelity designs into functional user interfaces.
• Work closely with backend developers and business analysts to understand backend capabilities and business... requirements.
• Debug and troubleshoot across multiple platforms to ensure optimal user experience.
• Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirement analysis to deployment.

What you bring & who you are:
• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• Extensive experience in frontend development, specifically with SAP UI5, demonstrated through a strong portfolio.
• Expertise in HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and related development tools.
• Knowledge of SAP Fiori design guidelines, SAP Cloud Platform, and integration technologies.
• Proficiency in additional programming languages like Node.js or ABAP is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
• Strong communication skills and fluency in English; German is a plus.

About the team:

You will be part of a forward-thinking, interdisciplinary team that operates both nationally and internationally. We are dedicated to continuous improvement and achieving excellence in our field. As part of our team, you will enjoy a dynamic, international, and team-oriented work environment that encourages the contribution of ideas and expertise to drive Axpo's success

jobs_results.title: Product Frontend Developer (React)
jobs_results.description:
Flowable is the leading provider of open-source Intelligent Business Automation solutions that combine the power of Case, Process and Decision support into a single platform.

Used by many of the world’s leading organizations like SAP, Dow Jones and other Fortune-500 companies, Flowable provides world-class Intelligent Automation solutions with a strong emphasis on human-centric workflow.

This is an ideal position for a skilled Senior Frontend Developer with a high level of proficiency in Typescript & React and the ability to work with Agile and DevOps fundamentals.

What you’ll be doing:
• Implement UI/UX design into responsive and feature-rich React components and pages
• Implement unit tests, integration tests and end-to-end tests to increase the code coverage of the Flowable frontend codebase.
• Guide and help other team members with code reviews, promoting best practices and adherence to coding standards
• Troubleshoot and debug frontend issues and propose solution options in a... timely manner

What you bring:

Do you have an open-minded personality with a passion for open source and new technologies? Do you enjoy working in agile software development and contributing to the on-going commercial success of a progressive, future-orientated business? If this sounds like you, then take a look at our technical requirements:
• Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on frontend software development experience with React.js
• Experience in Product Development
• Solid knowledge in JavaScript / TypeScript (+ES6), HTML, CSS / SASS
• Knowledge in testing technologies like Jest, Storybook, Cypress, Cucumber
• Fluent English

What you can expect:

You will enjoy flexible working hours, training, and home-office possibilities. However, we think these are the most interesting advantages of working at Flowable:
• Development of a worldwide-known open-source platform: By being involved in a code culture team, based on flat hierarchies, your ideas and expertise will have a direct impact on the development of an innovative, high-impact, product used by well-known international organizations.
• Our company culture: You will enjoy great team activities such as hackathons, Lunch&Learns, as well as social and sports events. We are an open company with flat hierarchies because we count on people, not titles
• Career growth: Flowable is a young company where you will be given the room to develop yourself and learn new things intensively while the company grows. Take the opportunity

jobs_results.title: FRONTEND DEVELOPER
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres desarrollarte como profesional en una empresa donde tendrás autonomía y verás el impacto de tu trabajo junto a un equipo que te ayudará en todo lo que necesites?

¡Esta posición te va a interesar!

En Idrica tenemos el propósito de crear un mundo mejor, ayudando a que la gestión del agua, nuestro bien más preciado, sea lo más eficiente posible.

Te aseguramos que aprenderás algo nuevo cada día, te enfrentarás a retos diferentes y te ofreceremos las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias para desarrollarte y crecer dentro de la empresa.

¿Por qué trabajar en IDRICA?

● Desarrollo profesional y autonomía para hacer tu trabajo: Tendrás la oportunidad de crecer en la empresa, estabilidad y trabajo durante mucho tiempo. Hay mucha confianza y, dentro de unas directrices generales marcadas, podrás decidir tus objetivos y organizarte como mejor consideres para lograrlos.

● Equipo comprometido que te ayudará en lo que necesites: Verás que hay mucho compañerismo y nunca te sentirás... solo/a ante el peligro. Somos una piña y todo el mundo estará dispuesto y disponible a responder a tus dudas o echarte una mano.

● Entorno híbrido donde podrás organizar tus horarios como quieras: Tendrás flexibilidad para organizar tu día a día, conciliando así tu vida laboral y personal. Trabajarás en un entorno híbrido porque nos encanta también ir a la oficina: compartimos desayuno, conectamos y solucionamos más cosas. No solo trabajas, también haces equipo.

● Cada día aprenderás algo nuevo y te enfrentarás a retos diferentes: Estamos creciendo muy rápido y tenemos que adaptarnos y dar solución a las nuevas situaciones que van surgiendo, lo que te ayudará a crecer tanto personal como profesionalmente.

● Sector en auge donde verás el impacto de tu trabajo en el día a día: El agua va a ser un bien cada vez más escaso y ayudamos a que su gestión sea lo más eficiente posible, aportando tu granito de arena a la mejora del medio ambiente.

Además de estos beneficios, podrás disfrutar de muchos otros:

Como eventos de teambuilding, plataformas de formación, catering subvencionado al 50% o de la plataforma iFeel, entre otros, con el objetivo de que tu día a día en Idrica sea mucho mejor.

Por lo que, si te incorporas al equipo algunas de tus funciones serán:
• Análisis y desarrollo de soluciones técnicas: Capacidad de toma de requisitos, Análisis funcional/orgánico, Diseño técnico y Desarrollo de la solución
• Estimación de tareas, planificación, ejecución y seguimiento
• Generación de documentación (análisis, plan de pruebas, manuales, etc.)
• Despliegues en entornos de Desarrollo y QA
• Apoyo al dep. de Soporte y a los compañeros del equipo (desarrolladores, diseñadores, analistas, etc.)
• Codificación de diseños técnicos usando los lenguajes React y Typescript.
• Redacción de documentación técnica.
• Elaboración de pruebas unitarias y de integración.
• Velar por mantener un nivel alto de calidad en el proceso de desarrollo.

¿Qué te hará triunfar en esta posición?
• Tener la suficiente experiencia como para ser autónomo/a en tu día a día.
• Poder mantener una conversación fluida en inglés, ya que trabajarás con equipos de diferentes países y tanto las reuniones como la comunicación escrita puede ser en inglés.
• Formación técnica en IT (Ingeniería informática o similares).
• Alto nivel de conocimiento (experto) de lenguajes de programación y arquitectura (idealmente React, Typescript).
• Clara orientación a la calidad y la mejora continua
• Conocimiento mínimo de Wiki, Jira, GIT y CI/CD.
• Acostumbrado a trabajar con metodologías Agile y Scrum.
• Experiencia en el desarrollo de proyectos software
• Postman o Swagger (Se valora, pero no requisito).
• Alto nivel de conocimiento (experto) de lenguajes de programación y arquitectura: React / Typescript.
• Redux
• Hooks
• Atomic design
• Librería de componentes (Nosotros usamos Devextreme. Se valora que lo conozca, pero no requisito)
• Librería de gráficos (Usamos Highcharts. Se valora que lo conozca, pero no requisito)
• BBDD PostgreSQL (Se valora que lo conozca, pero no requisito)
• Docker (Se valora que lo conozca, pero no requisito)
• Testing (Se valora, pero no requisito)

Así que, si quieres causar un impacto en el mundo, hacerlo de la mano de un equipo que te ayudará en lo que necesites y en una empresa donde las oportunidades de crecimiento son reales,
• ¡Idrica es tu sitio

jobs_results.title: Frontend developer with UI/UX skills
jobs_results.description:
About us:

We are an AI-Powered Sales Engagement & Lead Intelligence SaaS that helps B2B companies grow. We launched only one year ago and already have 18000+ companies using the tool to grow their business and get more leads. Our company is considered to be one of the fastest-growing bootstrapped startups in Europe.

Why we need you:

As our development team continues to expand, we are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with strong UI/UX skills to focus on frontend tasks. With the increasing complexity of our projects, we need someone who can bring expertise and precision to our frontend development processes.

Responsibilities:
• Convert Figma design files into high-quality React.js code.
• Collaborate with the engineering team to ensure integration of frontend components.
• Participate in UI/UX discussions and provide valuable insights for enhancing user experience.
• Take ownership of frontend tasks and deliver solutions within specified timelines.

Requirements:
•... Proficiency in React.js is required; experience with Next.js is optional but desirable.
• Strong intuition for aesthetically pleasing design
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote team environment.
• Fluent in English for daily conversations and team interactions.
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
• Experience working with UI/UX design tools such as Figma or Sketch.

Company perks
• Opportunity to work with a rapidly growing SaaS company in a dynamic industry;
• Chance to work with a talented and passionate team of professionals;
• Competitive salary and benefits package;
• Opportunity for career growth and advancement;
• Casual and dynamic work environment;
• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the success of our platform

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Hey, we're Sparta Commodities!

We are a Swiss, VC-backed scaleup with a global reach. Our mission is to digitize the commodity trading market and become the leading platform for traders in all commodities verticals. We've already gained significant market traction and are financially backed by Venture Investors.

We have a fantastic opportunity available for a driven and passionate Frontend Engineer to join our growing Engineering team, based remotely in Spain. This is a great career opportunity for an experienced and delivery-focused Engineer to play a key role in the development and maintenance of various front-end systems, including an Excel plug in, for a leading and highly regarded business. About The Team Our naturally diverse teams are divided into verticals, with a mix of multidisciplinary members. Each team has at least 3 Backend Engineers, 3 Frontend Engineers, a Designer, a QA Engineer, a Product Owner, and a Team Manager. We work on bi-weekly sprints with quarterly goals... Each project is kicked off by a product request, from which we build a technical proposal that is refined within the team. Once the project has been greenlit one team member becomes its owner. An owner follows the project through development and deployment, making the other team member accountable for their responsibilities. About The Tech We have a modern React website built using the latest Vite, using libraries such as Redux and SWR. Our Components are designed around Material UI and styled with SASS. We have plenty of financial data to graph in charts, for which we have extended chartjs. Our designers share Figma wireframes with beautiful adaptive designs. But our use of web technologies isn't limited to frontend. We share parts of our code with a Node backend. And we've also ventured into using TypeScript to develop Excel Add-Ins. In 2023 we doubled our website's screen count, with intentions to sextuple it by late 2024. We will also start serving content dynamically per customer, migrating from the unified experience we have today. About You We are looking for someone who has had ownership of projects from inception until after release, and who is familiar with observability, product metrics, and maintainability. They will be involved in the design of technical solutions as owner and implementor, on top of reviewing designs from other team members. On your day-to-day, you will work within the team reviewing code, and promoting initiatives to improve our code quality, maintainability, and development experience. As part of the development sprints, you will release new features and products using quality practices such as automated testing, QA validation, and monitorization. Requirements Ownership and accountability for projects and their product metrics Prior work in dashboards and/or customizable UI experiences Experience with Jest, Mocha or other common testing libs High communication skills in a remote-first company with a diverse workforce Bonus Points Knowledge of server-side rendering techniques and architectures Extensive experience with NextJS, Remix, Astro or similar A body of work in modular Design Systems Experience with cypress for e2e tests Prior work on real-time systems such as WebSockets, stock tickers, or videogames Experience and prior work with Redux What's the culture like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is not just a set of values written on a wall—it's a way of life. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives.

We're building an environment where our employees thrive and excel in their work. Our aim is for every member of our team to take pride in their contributions. You'll collaborate with like-minded individuals who are passionate about our mission and deeply committed to crafting outstanding products and achieving success for our customers.

We operate remotely, understanding that a thriving, profitable company isn't just about being in the same location. We build our relationships through effective remote work methods and carefully planned in-person meet-ups.

What We Offer

Remote working, with occasional travel to a central hub for collaborative meetings and coordination.

Attractive company stock option plan.

Yearly companywide meet-ups in sunny locations.

Training and education budget.

Private Medical Insurance. Access to the optimal gear suited for your position.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. As an international business, we are determined that suitably qualified persons will never receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. *Note for agencies- Please do not call or email any member of the Sparta team. All correspondence regarding interest in future partnerships should be directed to ******. Thank you for your understanding* #J-18808-Ljbffr
